content.concept_description: A player attempts to clear checkers from a board to reach a target green piece, trying different clearing moves.
content.why_it_works: Presents a clear puzzle goal and challenge text that engages viewers' problem-solving drive through satisfying tap-and-slide clearing mechanics.

visuals.notable_objects: Checkers pieces, puzzle board, award laurel wreaths

end_card.cta_and_text: 00:00 - 'I cannot reach green', '2025 BEST PUZZLE GAME', '2025 BEST GAME CREATIVE'

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: Tapping black and white checkers to slide them into corresponding color-matched slots to clear the board towards the green checker.

chapterization.chapter_description: Opening challenge text asking how to reach the green piece on the board.
Player taps checkers to clear pieces and open paths toward the target.
Gameplay restarts and repeats demonstration of clearing pieces.

_audit.problem: The ad features solely mobile screen gameplay framed by static graphics and text overlays with no live-action or cinematic animation components, so it is not a 'Hybrid' ad format.
At 00:00, the puzzle board is fully intact in its initial state before any moves have been made, so gameplay is not mid-action.
